package db

imports: fmt, regexp, sort, strings

var validIdentifier = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$`)

type queryType int
const ( querySelect queryType = iota; queryInsert; queryUpdate )

type QueryBuilder struct {
  qtype queryType
  table string
  columns []string       // SELECT columns
  whereClauses []string  // "col = $N" fragments
  whereArgs []any
  joins []string         // "LEFT JOIN t ON cond" fragments
  orderBys []string
  groupBys []string
  havingClauses []string
  havingArgs []any
  limitN *int
  offsetN *int
  // INSERT
  insertCols []string
  insertVals []any
  // UPDATE
  setClauses []string
  setArgs []any
  argCount int
}

func validateIdent(name string) error:
  if !validIdentifier.MatchString(name): return fmt.Errorf("invalid identifier: %q", name)
  return nil

func Select(columns ...string) *QueryBuilder:
  validate each column, set qtype=querySelect, store columns

func (q) From(table) *QueryBuilder: validate table, set q.table
func (q) Where(condition, args...) *QueryBuilder: q.argCount++, replace ? with $N in condition, append args
func (q) Join(joinType, table, on) *QueryBuilder: validate table, append formatted join string
func (q) OrderBy(col, dir) *QueryBuilder: validate col, dir must be ASC|DESC, append
func (q) Limit(n) *QueryBuilder: set limitN
func (q) Offset(n) *QueryBuilder: set offsetN
func (q) GroupBy(cols...) *QueryBuilder: validate each, append
func (q) Having(condition, args...) *QueryBuilder: similar to Where

func InsertInto(table) *QueryBuilder: validate, set qtype=queryInsert
func (q) Values(row map[string]any) *QueryBuilder:
  sort keys for deterministic order
  for each key: validate, append to insertCols, append value to insertVals

func Update(table) *QueryBuilder: validate, set qtype=queryUpdate
func (q) Set(col, val) *QueryBuilder: validate col, append "col = $N", append val

func (q) Build() (string, []any, error):
  switch qtype:
  case querySelect:
    if table == "": return error "SELECT requires FROM"
    sql = "SELECT " + join(columns, ", ") + " FROM " + table
    append joins, where (WHERE + AND join), groupBy, having, orderBy, limit, offset
    return sql, allArgs, nil
  case queryInsert:
    if table == "" or no cols: return error
    sql = "INSERT INTO " + table + " (cols) VALUES ($1, $2, ...)"
    return sql, insertVals, nil
  case queryUpdate:
    if table == "" or no setClauses: return error
    sql = "UPDATE " + table + " SET " + join(setClauses) + WHERE...
    return sql, append(setArgs, whereArgs...), nil
